inscription.name: Ledbergsstenen

carrier.currentLocationDescription: Nuvarande placering: Ledbergs kyrkogård, Ledbergs socken

textLayer.readingTransliteration: §A (b)isi · sati : st[(n)] : þisi : iftiʀ : þurkut : u----þi : faþur §B : sin : uk : þu : kuna : baþi : þmk:iii:sss:ttt:iii:l[(l)]l :
textLayer.normalizationRunicSwedish: §A Bisi satti stæin þennsi æftiʀ Þorgaut …, faður §B sinn ok þau Gunna baði. Þistill/mistill/kistill.
textLayer.normalizationOldWestNorse: §A Bisi setti stein þenna eptir Þorgaut …, fǫður §B sinn ok þau Gunna bæði. Þistill/mistill/kistill.
textLayer.translationSwedish: Bisi och Gunna läto resa denna sten efter Torgöt, sin fader… Tor vige dessa runor.
textLayer.translationEnglish: Bisi and Gunna had this stone raised in memory of Þorgautr, their father… May Thor hallow these runes.

images.caption: Ledbergsstenen (Ög 181), bildstensristning med Fenrisulven ur Östergötlands runinskrifter

inscription.editorialNotes: Bildsten på Ledbergs kyrkogård med förkristna scener tolkade som Fenrisulven slukande Oden vid Ragnarök, samt den magiska formeln 'Tor vige runorna'.
